@deskSetFrameSections.description: Accessibility label of the Settings sidebar list.

@deskSetFrameNode.description: Settings sidebar entry and page name for the node section. Narrow (about 200 px).

@deskSetFramePrivacy.description: Settings sidebar entry and page name for privacy and network routing. Narrow.

@deskSetFrameAppearance.description: Settings sidebar entry and page name for theme, language and display. Narrow.

@deskSetFrameThisWallet.description: Settings sidebar entry and page name for the open wallet (name, password, backup, delete). Narrow.

@deskSetFrameAllWallets.description: Settings sidebar entry and page name for the list of wallets on this computer. Narrow.

@deskSetFramePhrase.description: Settings sidebar entry and page name for showing the recovery phrase. Narrow.

@deskSetFrameRescan.description: Settings sidebar entry and page name for rescanning the chain to recheck the balance. Narrow.

@deskSetFrameAbout.description: Settings sidebar entry and page name for the About page. Narrow.

@deskSetFrameHelp.description: Settings sidebar entry and page name for the Help page. Narrow.

@deskSetFrameHealthOn.description: Status word of a service that works normally.

@deskSetFrameHealthSlow.description: Status word of a service that answers slowly.

@deskSetFrameNotResponding.description: Status word of a service or node that does not answer.

@deskSetFrameOff.description: Status word of a service that is switched off.

@deskSetFrameChecking.description: Status word while a service is being checked.

@deskSetFrameNodeSynced.description: Status word of a node that has the whole blockchain.

@deskSetFrameNodeSyncing.description: Status word of a node that is still downloading the blockchain.

@deskSetFrameNever.description: Time since an event that never happened. Lowercase, part of a line.

@deskSetFrameJustNow.description: Time since an event that happened less than a minute ago. Lowercase.

deskSetFrameMinAgo: {count, plural, one{{count} min ago} other{{count} min ago}}

@deskSetFrameMinAgo.description: Minutes since an event, abbreviated, e.g. "5 min ago".

deskSetFrameHoursAgo: {count, plural, one{{count} h ago} other{{count} h ago}}

@deskSetFrameHoursAgo.description: Hours since an event, abbreviated, e.g. "3 h ago".

deskSetFrameDaysAgo: {count, plural, one{{count} d ago} other{{count} d ago}}

@deskSetFrameDaysAgo.description: Days since an event, abbreviated, e.g. "2 d ago".

@deskSetComboOpens.description: Screen reader hint of the node and relay picker field.

@deskSetComboNoAnswer.description: Picker field: shown when a check takes long. Narrow.

@deskSetComboUse.description: Screen reader label of a picker row; the node’s details follow after a comma. {host} is a server address.

@deskSetFrameBack.description: Settings column: the button at its top that goes back to the wallet pages. Narrow.

@deskSetFrameBackTip.description: Tooltip of the Settings column’s back button. Esc is the key.

@deskSetFrameBackTo.description: Tooltip of a sub-page’s back link, e.g. "Back to Security".

@deskSetFrameEscKey.description: The Esc key as the keyboard shows it, in the Settings column’s foot.

@deskSetFrameEscHint.description: After the Esc key in the Settings column’s foot: what Esc does. Lowercase.

@deskSetFrameExperiment.description: Tag beside an experimental feature’s title (Linked devices).
